DEV_WRITE_BLOCKED:
WHAT: {command} would write outside the dev store and its throwaway repo.
WHY: Everything --dev does must stay inside <HAMMER_DEV_TASKS_DIR> and its <store>-repo; production paths are off limits.
HOW: Run '{command}' WITHOUT --dev if you really intend to change the real environment.
CONSEQUENCE: Stopped before any production write.
TASK_NOT_FOUND:
WHAT: Task '{filename}' missing.
WHY: HAMMER cannot operate on ghost. 
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks list' to see all existing task ID.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline remain BROKEN. SMASH BUG NOW.
INVALID_TASK_PATH:
WHAT: Path {filepath} invalid.
WHY: HAMMER require absolute obedience to directory structure.
HOW: Verify path exist, within task worktree.
CONSEQUENCE: Data corruption imminent. OBEY STRUCTURE.
TITLE_TOO_VAGUE:
WHAT: Title WEAK. Less than 10 character.
WHY: Weak title lead to weak task. HAMMER demand clarity.
HOW: Run: ./hammer tasks modify <id> --title "Stronger, clearer title here."
CONSEQUENCE: Task remain ignored. POUND INTO SHAPE.
NO_ACTIVE_TASK:
WHAT: No active task found.
WHY: Without an explicit id these commands would hit an arbitrary PROGRESSING task and mislabel its record. 
HOW: Pass the task id (see usage above).
CONSEQUENCE: Progress zero. SMASH WORK INTO MOTION.
BRANCH_NOT_PUSHED:
WHAT: Branch '{branch}' trapped locally.
WHY: HAMMER demand remote visibility.
HOW: Run 'git push origin {branch}' to expose work to team.
CONSEQUENCE: Other cannot see progress. OBEY SYNC.
MISSING_CONFIG_KEY:
WHAT: Config key missing.
WHY: HAMMER cannot configure nothing.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks config list' to see what you CAN set.
CONSEQUENCE: Tool misaligned. FIX IT.
MISSING_CONFIG_KEY_OR_VALUE:
WHAT: Incomplete config command.
WHY: HAMMER demand complete instruction.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks config set <key> <value>'.
CONSEQUENCE: Configuration remain WEAK. POUND IN CORRECT VALUE.
INVALID_TASK_TYPE:
WHAT: Invalid type '{task_type}'.
WHY: TYPE DISOBEDIENCE. HAMMER only know: task, issue, doc, test.
HOW: Use valid type.
CONSEQUENCE: Task rejected. FIX TYPE.
PRIORITY_INVALID:
WHAT: Priority broken. Must 1-9.
WHY: HAMMER must POUND high priority first.
HOW: Set priority between 1 (highest) and 9 (lowest).
CONSEQUENCE: Ordering chaos. RESTORE ORDER.
TASK_EXISTS:
WHAT: Task {task_id} already claim identity.
WHY: DUPLICATE FOUND. HAMMER crush duplicate.
HOW: Rename task or use existing.
CONSEQUENCE: Collision risk. AVOID IT.
TASK_ID_EXISTS:
WHAT: Numeric ID {numeric_id} in state '{state}' already taken.
WHY: ID COLLISION. POUNDING STOPPED.
HOW: Choose fresh ID.
CONSEQUENCE: Worktree corruption. AVOID IT.
INIT_REQUIRED:
WHAT: Task not initialized.
WHY: NO WORKTREE FOUND. HAMMER need foundation.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks init'.
CONSEQUENCE: Hammer BLADE-LESS. FIX FOUNDATION.
INVALID_CONFIG_KEY:
WHAT: Invalid config key '{key}'.
WHY: UNKNOWN CONFIGURATION. HAMMER ignore unknown.
HOW: Allowed: {allowed_keys}. Run 'hammer tasks config list'.
CONSEQUENCE: Configuration error. FIX KEY.
AUTO_PROMOTE_FAIL:
WHAT: Auto-promotion fail.
WHY: Repository integration break.
HOW: Check git status/merge conflict.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. FIX NOW.
FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION:
WHAT: Transition {from_state} -> {to_state} forbidden.
WHY: Pipeline governance violation.
HOW: {task_id} is on {from_state}. Use 'hammer tasks move {task_id} {next_valid_state}' to proceed.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline flow halted.
LINK_TASK_NOT_FOUND:
WHAT: Link target missing.
WHY: HAMMER cannot link to nothing.
HOW: Verify both tasks exist with 'hammer tasks list'.
CONSEQUENCE: Link chain broken. FIX ID.
LINK_SELF:
WHAT: Link to self forbidden.
WHY: SELF-REFERENCE IS WEAK. Loops break logic.
HOW: Link to a different task.
CONSEQUENCE: Logic corruption. AVOID IT.
CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY:
WHAT: Cycle detected: {filename} -> {blocked_by}.
WHY: CIRCULAR DEPENDENCY DETECTED. HAMMER forbid loop.
HOW: Break cycle by linking to non-dependent task.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline deadlock. FIX LOGIC.
NO_REMOTE_CONFIGURED:
WHAT: No remote configured.
WHY: HAMMER need remote to push work.
HOW: Configure remote git repository or use --dev/--yes flag.
CONSEQUENCE: Work trapped locally. FIX REMOTE.
PUSH_FAIL:
WHAT: Push fail: {stderr}.
WHY: Git push blocked.
HOW: Check network and git status.
CONSEQUENCE: Work trapped. FIX PUSH.
UNKNOWN_SECTION:
WHAT: Unknown section '{section}'.
WHY: SECTION DISOBEDIENCE. HAMMER do not know '{section}'.
HOW: Use: story, tech, criteria, plan, repro, notes, progress.
CONSEQUENCE: Output remain EMPTY. FIX SECTION.
UNFINISHED_CHECKBOXES:
WHAT: Task contain unfinished checkbox (- [ ]).
WHY: INCOMPLETE CRITERIA. HAMMER forbid promotion.
HOW: Merely marking checkboxes is not the goal. Confirm each subtask is genuinely complete, then use './hammer tasks show <id>' to verify criteria before retrying.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline halt. FIX CRITERIA.
REGRESSION_CHECK_NOT_PASSED:
WHAT: Regression check not passed (Rc flag not set).
WHY: Pipeline governance require regression check.
HOW: 1. FULLY review all patches in '.tasks/review/{task_id}/patches/'. Use 'cat' on each file to confirm review.
2. Run './hammer tasks modify {task_id} --reviewed' to confirm review.
3. Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}' to generate a formal audit record.
4. Run './hammer tasks modify {task_id} --regression-check' to pass the gate.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. FIX NOW.
BRANCH_NOT_MERGED:
WHAT: Task branch '{branch}' not merged to main.
WHY: Integration rule broken.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks move {task_id} DONE' (must be in STAGING).
CONSEQUENCE: Integration halted. FIX SYNC.
AUDIT_PATCH_MISSING:
WHAT: Regression patches missing from {patches_dir}.
WHY: Patch generation failure or migration issue (patches not found in STAGING).
HOW: 1. Move task back to REVIEW using './hammer tasks move {task_id} REVIEW -y'.
     2. This will re-trigger the migration logic to move patches from REVIEW to STAGING.
     3. Then try moving to STAGING again.
CONSEQUENCE: Audit impossible. FIX PATH.
AUDIT_MISSING:
WHAT: Cryptographic audit missing: {audit_path}.
WHY: Code review required.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}'.
CONSEQUENCE: Audit chain broken. OBEY AUDIT.
PROOF_MISSING:
WHAT: Verification proof missing: {proof_path}.
WHY: The pipeline requires a formal record of criteria verification.
HOW: 1. Review criteria at: /home/vscode/git/tasks-ai/.tasks/progressing/{task_id}/criteria.md.
     2. Run "./hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "<your_brief_verification_statement>"".
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. SATISFY AUDIT.
HASH_MISSING:
WHAT: Audit integrity check failed.
WHY: The audit chain is broken or incomplete (missing hash).
HOW: 1. Confirm criteria at: /home/vscode/git/tasks-ai/.tasks/progressing/{task_id}/criteria.md.
     2. Run "./hammer tasks audit {task_id}" to generate the audit record.
     3. Run "./hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "<summary>"" to bind the proof and hash the integrity of criteria, proof, and audit.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. SATISFY AUDIT.
AUDIT_MISMATCH:
WHAT: Audit mismatch. Code change since last audit.
HOW: 1. Re-review patch. 2. Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}'. 3. Run './hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "..."'.
CONSEQUENCE: Integrity fail. LOCK CHAIN.
INTEGRITY_MISMATCH:
WHAT: Integrity mismatch. Criteria, proof, or audit change.
WHY: Cryptographic lock broken.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}' && './hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "..."'.
CONSEQUENCE: Integrity fail. LOCK CHAIN.
BRANCH_CHECKOUT_FAIL:
WHAT: Failed checkout branch '{branch}'.
WHY: Git checkout failure.
HOW: Check branch name and git status.
CONSEQUENCE: Sync halted. FIX BRANCH.
MERGE_CONFLICT:
WHAT: Merge conflict: {branch} with {default}.
WHY: CONFLICT DETECTED. HAMMER break.
HOW: Resolution Steps:
   1. Switch to the task branch:

       git checkout {branch}
   2. Merge the {default} branch into the task branch:
       git merge {default}
   3. Resolve the conflicts in the files indicated by 'git status'.
   4. Commit the resolution:

       git commit -m "[{task_id}] Resolved merge conflict with {default} branch"
   5. Re-attempt the move:

       ./hammer tasks move {task_id} TESTING
CONSEQUENCE: Integration fail. OBEY RESOLUTION.
MAIN_BRANCH_PROTECTION:
WHAT: You are attempting a task movement or commit directly on the '{default_branch}' branch.
WHY: Pipeline governance requires all work to happen on task-specific branches.
HOW: 1. Run 'hammer tasks list' to identify your task.
     2. Run 'git checkout <task-branch-name>' to switch to the correct task branch.
     3. Retry the operation.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline is protected. Operation blocked to prevent corruption.
NO_PROGRESS_UPDATE:
WHAT: No progress update detected.
WHY: PROGRESS STAGNATION. HAMMER demand record.
HOW: Update {progress_path} or {current_path} with progress, finding, mitigation.
CONSEQUENCE: Progress unknown. SUBMIT UPDATE.
INIT_EXPLANATION:
WHAT: Initialize workspace storage.
WHY: FOUNDATION REQUIRED.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks init'.
CONSEQUENCE: No init, no foundation, no task. INIT NOW.
TOO_SHORT:
WHAT: TOO SHORT: {too_short}.
WHY: INSUFFICIENT DETAIL. HAMMER demand substance.
HOW: Provide more detail.
CONSEQUENCE: Task rejected. FIX CONTENT.
STATE_REQUIRED:
WHAT: Task {task_id} must be in {required_state} state.
WHY: PIPELINE GOVERNANCE VIOLATION.
HOW: Use './hammer tasks move <id> {required_state}'.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion blocked. OBEY PIPELINE.
MISSING_PARTS:
WHAT: Mandatory task parameters are missing: {missing_parts}.
WHY: HAMMER command is incomplete.
HOW: Usage: tasks create '<title>' --story '<story>' --tech '<tech>' --criteria '<criteria>' --plan '<plan>'{issue_repro}.
CONSEQUENCE: Command aborted. FIX INSTRUCTION.
INTEGRITY_VIOLATION:
WHAT: Task location mismatch detected.
WHY: TAMPERING DETECTED. Folder does not match state.
HOW: 1. Do not move folders manually. 2. Run './hammer tasks doctor --fix'.
CONSEQUENCE: Data corruption threat. LOCKING ACCESS.
PIPELINE_VALIDATION_FAILED:
WHAT: Pipeline validation failed: {msg}.
WHY: Governance rules broken.
HOW: Run './hammer check all' to identify failure.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. FIX FAILURES.
TEST_FAILURE:
WHAT: Test failure: {msg}.
WHY: Regression detected.
HOW: Run 'pytest' to debug failure. 2. Fix test.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. FIX TEST.
AUDIT_FAILURE:
WHAT: Audit failed: {audit_code}.
WHY: Governance requirement unmet.
HOW: Task moved back to PROGRESSING. Update criteria/plan for task {task_id} using 'hammer tasks modify {task_id} --criteria <new_criteria> --plan <new_plan>'.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted.
MAIN_DIVERGED:
WHAT: Local main branch is out of sync.
WHY: Divergence from origin/main detected.
HOW: Run 'git fetch origin && git pull origin main' to sync local main before promoting.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion to main blocked.
NO_DEFAULT_BRANCH:
WHAT: No default branch to promote into.
WHY: Neither 'main' nor 'master' exists, so pipeline gates cannot verify integration.
HOW: Create one (git checkout -b main) or set git config init.defaultBranch.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion blocked.
CLEANUP_BRANCH_INVALID:
WHAT: Cleanup run from wrong branch: {current_branch}.
WHY: HAMMER require stable integration branch.
HOW: Run from {default_branch}, staging, or testing branch.
CONSEQUENCE: Cleanup blocked. OBEY BRANCH.
WORKTREE_NOT_FOUND:
WHAT: Worktree not found for task {task_id}.
WHY: No dedicated worktree has been created for this task.
HOW: Run 'tasks mount {task_id}' to create and mount a worktree.
CONSEQUENCE: Task work cannot be isolated. CREATE WORKTREE.
WORKTREE_MERGE_CONFLICT:
WHAT: Merge conflict: {branch} with {default}.
WHY: CONFLICT DETECTED during worktree sync.
HOW: Resolution Steps:
   1. Navigate to the worktree: 'cd $(tasks mount {task_id})'
   2. Resolve the conflicts in the files indicated by 'git status'.
   3. Commit the resolution:

       git commit -m "[{task_id}] Resolved merge conflict with {default} branch"
   4. Re-attempt the move:

       ./hammer tasks move {task_id} TESTING
CONSEQUENCE: Integration fail. OBEY RESOLUTION.
WORKTREE_MISSING_AUTO_DEMOTED:
WHAT: Worktree '{branch}' missing, auto-demoted to PROGRESSING.
WHY: Task worktree was not found.
HOW: Run 'tasks mount {task_id}' to recreate the worktree.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. MOUNT WORKTREE.
CONFLICT_DETECTED:
WHAT: Merge conflicts detected in worktree '{branch}'.
WHY: Code changes conflict with target branch.
HOW:
   1. Navigate to the worktree: 'cd $(tasks mount {task_id})'
   2. Run: git status (to see conflicted files)
   3. Resolve conflicts manually
   4. Stage and commit: git add . && git commit -m 'Resolved conflicts'
   5. Re-attempt the move.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. RESOLVE CONFLICT.
GUARD_DUPLICATE_ID:
WHAT: Task ID {task_id} claimed by MULTIPLE branch.
WHY: DUPLICATE ID. HAMMER cannot know which branch is the real task.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks doctor --fix' to reconcile — the guard never deletes branches itself. --force overrides (bypass is logged).
CONSEQUENCE: Silent task identity corruption. REJECTED.
GUARD_DUPLICATE_REMOTE_ID:
WHAT: Task ID {task_id} claimed by MULTIPLE REMOTE branch.
WHY: REMOTE DUPLICATE. Origin disagrees with itself about which task is real.
HOW: Run 'hammer guard refresh --fetch', then 'hammer tasks doctor --fix' to reconcile. --force overrides (bypass is logged).
CONSEQUENCE: Remote identity corruption. REJECTED.
GUARD_STATE_DUPLICATE:
WHAT: Task ID {task_id} live in MULTIPLE state folder.
WHY: SAME ID IN TWO PLACES. HAMMER guess which one is real — guess is not authority.
HOW: Run 'hammer guard scan' for the full list, then 'hammer tasks doctor --fix' to reconcile. --force overrides (bypass is logged).
CONSEQUENCE: Corrupted state, silent divergence. REJECTED.
GUARD_BRANCH_NONCONFORMANT:
WHAT: Branch '{branch}' BREAK CONVENTION.
WHY: HAMMER demand <id>-<type>-<slug>.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks doctor --fix' to correct metadata 'Br' to the folder name. --force overrides (bypass is logged).
CONSEQUENCE: Guard cannot verify identity. REJECTED.
GUARD_BRANCH_MISSING:
WHAT: Task {task_id} has NO LOCAL BRANCH.
WHY: {to_state} require the branch to exist and be pushed.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks mount {task_id}' to restore it, or move the task back to PROGRESSING.
CONSEQUENCE: Work trapped locally. REJECTED.
GUARD_REMOTE_DIVERGENCE:
WHAT: Task {task_id} has NO LOCAL BRANCH; remote still tracks it.
WHY: LOCAL WORK LOST. Origin holds a copy the local repo cannot see.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks mount {task_id}' to restore the branch from origin, then 'hammer tasks doctor --fix'. --force overrides (bypass is logged).
CONSEQUENCE: Work invisible to this repo. REJECTED.
GUARD_WORKTREE_PATH_DRIFT:
WHAT: A task's worktree is not at <worktrees_base>/<branch>.
WHY: Hammer owns worktree paths; a consumer resolving that task by name would read or write outside the registered worktree.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks mount <id>' to re-register, or 'hammer tasks doctor' for the full report. --force overrides (bypass is logged).
CONSEQUENCE: Path resolution is ambiguous. REJECTED.
GUARD_WORKTREE_MISSING_WORKTREE:
WHAT: A manifest worktree path is not a git worktree.
WHY: The directory hammer registered is gone or was never created, so the task has no working directory.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks mount <id>' to recreate it. --force overrides (bypass is logged).
CONSEQUENCE: The task has nowhere to build. REJECTED.
GUARD_WORKTREE_UNREGISTERED:
WHAT: A directory under .task-worktrees/ is not in the manifest.
WHY: Nobody owns that path; anything resolving a task through it works outside hammer's control.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks doctor --fix' to remove unregistered directories, or move the work to the registered path.
CONSEQUENCE: Phantom paths. REJECTED.
GUARD_WORKTREE_ORPHAN:
WHAT: Worktree for task {task_id} has NO MATCHING BRANCH.
WHY: ORPHANED WORKTREE. It points at a branch that no longer exists.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks doctor --fix' to reconcile worktrees. --force overrides (bypass is logged).
CONSEQUENCE: Dangling workspace. REJECTED.
GUARD_WORKTREE_MISSING:
WHAT: Task {task_id} has NO WORKTREE.
WHY: {to_state} require a worktree for the task's branch.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks mount {task_id}' to create it. --force overrides (bypass is logged).
CONSEQUENCE: Task cannot be worked on. REJECTED.
GUARD_UNAVAILABLE:
WHAT: Guard CANNOT VERIFY task {task_id}.
WHY: Cache corrupt or git subprocess failed. Guard fail closed — a silent pass is the bug this tool exists to kill.
HOW: Run 'hammer guard rebuild' then retry. --force overrides and logs the bypass.
CONSEQUENCE: Unverified transition. REJECTED.
STORE_WRITE_FAIL:
WHAT: Git refused to stage or commit this task's store changes.
WHY: The shared .tasks store is one repo used by every agent; a failed write means this update exists on disk but never reaches the record, and would be silently lost.
HOW: Check for a stale .tasks/.git/index.lock or a broken store repo, then retry the checkpoint.
CONSEQUENCE: Task record incomplete. Do not retry blindly.
DEV_REPO_UNAVAILABLE:
WHAT: --dev could not bind to a throwaway repo.
WHY: Every --dev git write must land outside the real repo, or dev-created branches, worktrees and guard findings later block real tasks.
HOW: Fix the clone source reported above, or run '{command}' WITHOUT --dev to work on the real repository.
CONSEQUENCE: Stopped before any real repository write.
DEV_COMMAND_REFUSED:
WHAT: '{command}' writes to the shared remote.
WHY: A --dev store is throwaway; pushing from it moves real refs.
HOW: Run '{command}' without --dev to reach the real environment.
CONSEQUENCE: Nothing was pushed.
RESEARCH_REQUIRED:
WHAT: Research pass not recorded.
WHY: HAMMER demand read-only research (codebase file / online search) before BUILD.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks modify {task_id} --research "<findings>"'. File path work for bulk note.
CONSEQUENCE: READY -> PROGRESSING stay blocked. NO research, NO submit.
CONTENT_FILE_NOT_FOUND:
WHAT: Content file not found: {path}.
WHY: Long-form flag got path-shaped value that name no file.
HOW: Pass real path, or plain string content.
CONSEQUENCE: Task not modified.
PARENT_NOT_FOUND:
WHAT: Parent task not found: {parent}.
WHY: HAMMER cannot link child task to missing parent.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks list' and pass valid parent id.
CONSEQUENCE: Task not created.
TASK_METADATA_CORRUPTED:
WHAT: Task metadata corrupted.
WHY: HAMMER cannot read task record.
HOW: Run 'hammer doctor --fix' or recreate the task.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline flow halted.
